powers.title: Arcane Anchor
powers.description: You trigger latent enchantments placed on yourself or an ally to resist being pushed around the area.
rows: Trigger: You or an ally are affected by a push, pull, or slide effect
Target: The triggering creature
Effect: The forced movement is negated.

powers.title: Arcane Springboard
powers.description: Infusing a small square of prepared cloth with arcane energy, you create a bouncy surface that launches any who step on it.
rows: Effect: You conjure an arcane springboard in a square within range. The springboard lasts until the end of your next turn. You or any ally who enters the square can jump a number of squares equal to your Wisdom. The distance jumped does not count toward a character's movement. A character can benefit from this conjuration's effect only once per turn.
Sustain Minor: The conjuration persists.
powers.source: Published in Eberron Player's Guide, page(s) 48.

powers.title: Bolster Armor
powers.description: You touch some armor, causing it to glow as you enhance its defenses.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target gains a +1 power bonus to AC until the end of the encounter. When hit by an attack, the target can end this bonus as a free action to gain a +4 bonus to AC against that attack.
powers.source: Published in Eberron Player's Guide, page(s) 48.

powers.title: Restorative Infusion
powers.description: You infuse a comrade with a restorative compound. That ally can then redirect excess vitality to your other allies.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target gains 20 temporary hit points. As a minor action, the target can transfer any number of these temporary hit points to an ally within 5 squares of him or her.
powers.source: Published in Eberron Player's Guide, page(s) 49.

powers.title: Shadowy Figurine
powers.description: Your magic creates an ebon figurine cloaked in shadow. Tendrils of dim light stretch from the figurine and envelop you and your allies in obscurity.
rows: Effect: You conjure a shadowy figurine in a square within range. The figurine lasts until the end of your next turn. While within 2 squares of the figurine, you and your allies gain partial concealment and a +4 power bonus to Stealth checks.
Sustain Minor: The figurine persists until the end of your next turn, and you can move it up to 5 squares.

powers.title: Swift Mender
powers.description: You empower a tiny construct to zoom to an ally's aid.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target makes a saving throw.
powers.source: Published in Eberron Player's Guide, page(s) 49.

powers.title: Use Magic Item
powers.description: Your knowledge unlocks the power in a magic item without expending your own energy.
rows: Effect: The next magic item daily power you use before the end of your next turn does not count toward your limit of magic item daily power uses.
powers.source: Published in Eberron Player's Guide, page(s) 49.

powers.title: Animate Helper
powers.description: You' ve crafted the perfect assistant for your task.
rows: Effect: You gain a bonus to your next skill check before the end of your turn equal to your Wisdom.
powers.source: Published in Eberron Player's Guide, page(s) 50.

powers.title: Energy Conversion
powers.description: Your spell absorbs the energy of your enemy's attacks, turning it into a protective ward for your ally.
rows: Trigger: An ally takes damage from an attack
Target: The triggering ally
Effect: The target gains resist all equal to 5 + your Wisdom against the triggering attack. After the attack is resolved, the ally gains temporary hit points equal 5 + your Wisdom.

powers.title: Healing Reserve
powers.description: You channel arcane energy to assist an ally's healing.
rows: Trigger: An ally within 10 squares of you spends a healing surge to regain hit points.
Target: The triggering ally
Effect: The target does not expend the healing surge but still gains its benefit. The target regains additional hit points equal to your Wisdom.
powers.source: Published in Eberron Player's Guide, page(s) 50.

powers.title: Phantom Structure
powers.description: By arranging small objects in your hand, you create an ephemeral structure made of magical force.
rows: Effect: Choose a square within range and another square within range and within 2 + your Intelligence squares of the chosen square. You create a phantasmal bridge between the two squares that lasts until the end of your next turn. The bridge connects the two chosen squares by the shortest path. The bridge has no height, and a creature can pass through a square containing the bridge as though it were normal terrain, even if it normally contains no terrain, difficult terrain, challenging terrain, or hindering terrain.
Sustain Minor: The bridge persists.
powers.source: Published in Eberron Player's Guide, page(s) 50.

powers.title: Regeneration Infusion
powers.description: You imbue an ally's equipment with a steady flow of arcane energy, which restores your friend's vigor.
rows: Target: You or one ally in the burst; target must be bloodied
Effect: The target gains regeneration equal to your Constitution until the end of the encounter. As a minor action, the target can end the effect to spend a healing surge.
powers.source: Published in Eberron Player's Guide, page(s) 50.

powers.title: Dancing Shield
powers.description: A small metal sheaf unfolds into a medium-sized shield that floats near an ally and blocks incoming attacks.
rows: Target: One ally

Effect: You conjure a shield of metal and magic to protect the target. The target gains a +4 power bonus to AC and Reflex until the end of the encounter or until you move the shield. As a minor action, you can move the shield to a new target within range. That ally then gains the bonus.
powers.source: Published in Eberron Player's Guide, page(s) 51.

powers.title: Recuperative Enchantment
powers.description: You trigger enchantments placed on your ally's armor that temporarily infuses them with healing energy.
rows: Trigger: An ally in range spends a healing surge
Target: The triggering ally
Effect: The target heals additional hit points equal to his or her healing surge value.

powers.title: Sigil of Luck
powers.description: You imbue a weapon or an implement with a dose of luck and arcane energy.
rows: Target: One weapon or implement

Effect: Until the end of the encounter, any attack that uses the target gains a +1 power bonus to attack rolls and a bonus to damage rolls equal to your Constitution. As a minor action, the target's wielder can end the effect in order to remove an effect on him or her that a save can end.
powers.source: Published in Eberron Player's Guide, page(s) 52.

powers.title: Slick Concoction
powers.description: You direct a magical liquid under your allies' feet, causing them to slip across the battle field.
rows: Target: Each ally in the burst
Effect: You slide each target 5 squares. Each target gains a +4 bonus to Reflex until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Eberron Player's Guide, page(s) 52.
